departmentId.description: CHANGED from the original draft's 'departmentCode' primary key to match the framework's {camel}Id/prefix convention confirmed in userPayloadValidation.json and livestockbreedPayloadValidation.json (main.py's PrimaryKeyUtil reads prefix/key/keyLength off this exact field name). NOTE: this still leaves the open primary-key modelling question from earlier unresolved for other entities -- applying the 'two field' default here (system id separate from any human-facing code) since the wireframe's visible 'Department Code' (e.g. DPT-053170765364) reads as a separate, possibly still auto-generated, business code -- see 'departmentCode' below.

departmentCode.description: Human-facing department code shown throughout the UI (wireframe: 'DPT-053170765364'). Auto-generated, unique, stored uppercase, read-only after creation (PRD Epic 1.1, 1.4, 15. Glossary).

name.description: Department name (PRD Epic 1.1; wireframe 'Department Name'). Mandatory.

type.description: Department type, configurable list (PRD Epic 1.3; wireframe 'Department Type' dropdown, e.g. Agricultural, Seed Production, Research, Distribution, Processing per the wireframe's populated table).

parentDepartmentId.description: Optional reference to another department (wireframe 'Parent Department (Optional)' dropdown; PRD Epic 1.3).

coverage.description: CHANGED from a flat string array to a structured 4-level hierarchy, confirmed by the wireframe's cascading Region / Zone / Woreda / Kebele selectors (Add/Edit Department screens). Values are expected to reference the Location catalogue in agri-catalogue-service (locationobject), not be typed freely -- confirm the exact reference shape with that service's team. A child department's coverage cannot exceed its parent's (PRD 14.2).

status.description: Wireframe listing shows Active/Inactive as the two live states (PRD adds Draft for bulk-created records, Epic 1.7).

notes: Primary key modelling changed since the last version delivered -- previously used 'departmentCode' as the JSON-schema primary key; now split into a system 'departmentId' (framework convention) and a human-facing 'departmentCode' (business identifier), consistent with the two-field pattern discussed earlier. This is a proposed resolution, not a confirmed team decision -- flag if you want the single-field version instead.

'type' enum values were not enumerated in the PRD; the wireframe's populated table shows Agricultural / Seed Production / Research / Distribution / Processing as examples -- confirm the authoritative fixed list before deploying.
